name: alphaxiv
description: Query the alphaXiv research API (api.alphaxiv.org MCP endpoint). {"tool": "list"} enumerates the server's tools and their input schemas; any other value calls that tool with {"args": {...}}. Research tools include discover_papers (search/rank papers), get_paper_content (full text or AI report for an arXiv id), answer_pdf_queries (page-level Q&A over papers), and read_files_from_github_repository (browse a paper's codebase). Requires the ALPHAXIV_API_KEY environment variable (alphaxiv.org, Settings > API Keys). Returns {"ok": true, "text": "..."} truncated to max_chars (default 16000).
llm_description: alphaXiv research API. {tool, args?, max_chars?}: tool="list" enumerates server tools + schemas; else calls it (discover_papers, get_paper_content, answer_pdf_queries, read_files_from_github_repository). Needs ALPHAXIV_API_KEY.

tool.description: Server tool name, or "list" to enumerate available tools

args.description: Arguments for the named server tool (see "list" for its schema)

max_chars.description: Truncate the reply to this many characters (default 16000)
